description:
Updated Translation of Traverser Design Bureau by Hanliu

Translated by Myco and Miko. Thanks to Iriscoral who have worked on previous translation version and was used for reference (with permission). (Please note given the overhaul of the mod has gotten since, most TL have been redone)

Dependencies:

Lazy Lib

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=5444.0

Magic Lib

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25868.0

Graphic Lib

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=10982.0

Download :

UNGP and Nex support.

Traverser Association is an organization built by outcasts from another world in hopes of survival. Before this, they were a large mercenary band working for the independents league. As their power grew, they begin to settle systems they have discovered by chance, and through integration of their survey findings ands technologies of various worlds, they built their worlds into a real fortress. From there, they built an association formed by other Traversers and like-minded individuals. A core institution called [Traverser Design Bureau] guide this faction forward. As an extremely xenophilic faction, they are welcoming and warm, but also bound by strict regulations. As long as you follow their laws, they will welcome your arrival.

What can be certain is that the association is providing special warships and weapons to reputable clients.

Faction Feature

Most ship have fairly strong shield resistance with weaker armor. They focus on Missile Strike and Carrier Strike. Now, you can modify their built in basic hull mods to further change their fighting style in a flexible manner.

Adds a faction with their own unique line of ships and support drone ships, together with a series of weapons and hull mods, as well as a few minor quest line.

aiDescription: Adds a new faction called the Traverser Association, featuring unique ships, support drones, weapons, and hull mods. The faction has a focus on missile and carrier-based combat, with customizable hull mods to adapt their fighting style. It includes a minor quest line and a xenophilic, law-bound culture with a strong emphasis on integration and survival.
